held.title: New uses of `Kysely`, `DB` and `AssetRepository` come with no added imports.
held.body: The CHANGES block counts +36 lines for this file, and all 36 are in these two hunks. That leaves no room for new import lines, yet the change adds `let db: Kysely<DB>` and calls `ctx.get(AssetRepository)`. The test still runs under vitest because esbuild strips types, but if the file did not already import `Kysely`, `DB` and `AssetRepository`, the server type-check (`tsc`/lint) fails, and the `AssetRepository` value reference fails at runtime. I can't see the file's import section to confirm. If any of these imports is missing, add it (`import { Kysely } from 'kysely'`, `DB` from the schema, `AssetRepository` from its repository).

held.title: Updating the step orders one row at a time can collide on a unique (workflowId, order) index.
held.body: If `createWorkflow` gives the steps orders 0 and 1 by insert position, the action has 0 and the filter has 1. This loop may set the action to 1 while the filter still holds 1. If `workflow_step` has a unique, non-deferrable constraint on (workflowId, order), the update throws and the test fails for a reason unrelated to the fix. I can't see the schema to check whether that constraint exists. To be safe, swap the values in a single `UPDATE ... SET order = CASE ...` statement, or move one row to a temporary value first.
